Artificial Christmas Tree
This artificial Christmas tree adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green finish and plastic and metal construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Plastic and Metal. Colour: Green. Stated size: 150 cm. Product weight: 5.1 kg. Quantity: 1 piece.
Compact artificial Christmas tree designed to add festive detail and serve as a focal point for home displays.
Constructed from durable plastic and metal materials to provide a defined appearance and long-lasting decorative use.
Versatile green finish allows it to complement various interior styles and coordinate with other seasonal decorations.
Easy to position and store, allowing flexible arrangement within your holiday display without requiring complex setup.
Guarantee - 1 month
Artificial christmas tree type: Table top
Assembly required
With stand

Lightweight Design
The lightweight form is convenient to handle and move between suitable locations. It also makes the item easier to include when organising a bag or storage space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

5056797098367.sourceDescription:
Add festive fun to your Christmas decorating with this 31cm acrylic LED gingerbread man from MySmartBuy. The cheerful gingerbread design is lit with 30 warm white LEDs, and the durable acrylic catches the light for a cosy glow that delights children and grown-ups alike. Place him in a window, on the porch, beside the path or in the garden. Pair him with the 30cm acrylic gingerbread woman from the same range for a sweet festive couple. Suitable for indoor and outdoor use. It runs on batteries, so there are no cables to trail and no need for a nearby socket. Light up figures are one of the easiest ways to make your home stand out at Christmas. Group several together to tell a festive story on the lawn, use them to frame the front door or path, or place one where it can be seen from the window so the whole family can enjoy it from inside too. Pair it with other MySmartBuy light up figures, trees and wreaths to build a full festive display that neighbours, visitors and passers-by will love. At a glance: 31cm gingerbread man | durable acrylic | 30 warm white LEDs | battery operated | indoor and outdoor use.
31CM GINGERBREAD MAN : A cheerful acrylic gingerbread man lit with 30 warm white LEDs.
DURABLE ACRYLIC : Catches the light beautifully and can be enjoyed year after year.
MATCHING RANGE : Pairs with the 30cm acrylic gingerbread woman.
BATTERY OPERATED : Runs on batteries, so there are no trailing cables and no need for a nearby socket.
INDOOR AND OUTDOOR USE : Lovely in windows, porches, pathways and gardens.

5056797097667.sourceDescription:
Create an enchanting garden display with this outdoor pre-lit tree from MySmartBuy. Thousands of warm white micro LEDs sit on fine copper wire branches, clustering together to create a delicate, dazzling flower-like effect that sparkles beautifully after dark. It is available in 150cm with 2000 micro LEDs or 180cm with 3000 micro LEDs. The sturdy metal base keeps it stable on patios, terraces and pathways, and it makes an elegant feature beside the front door or in a covered entrance. It is supplied with a 5m lead cable and BS IP20 transformer, giving plenty of reach from your socket. Light up trees are a clever way to add festive height and impact without the mess of a real tree. 5058194835767.sourceDescription:
Christmas Wreath
This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The gold finish and PVC construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Glitter Finish
The glitter finish adds a light catching detail to the surface. It brings a more textured appearance to the decorative arrangement and pairs well with plain finishes when you want the smaller design elements to remain visible.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details
Material: PVC. Colour: Gold. Stated size: 20 m. Quantity: 1 piece.
Festive gold PVC wreath with a sparkling glitter finish for Christmas decoration.
Versatile decorative detail suitable for enhancing door displays and home arrangements.
Designed to create a focal point with its defined outline and textured surface.
Single item pack containing one 20m festive wreath for easy seasonal styling.
Comes with 1 x Christmas Wreath

This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The black finish and plastic construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Zip Fastening
The zip fastening keeps the opening together while allowing direct access when needed. Open it fully to arrange the contents and close it before carrying or storing the item.

Water Resistant
The water resistant construction is useful where occasional moisture is part of the intended use. Allow damp surfaces to dry after use and follow the stated limits for exposure.

Compact Format
The compact format helps the item fit into a smaller working or storage area. It is useful where you want the function close to hand without filling the whole space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Colour: Black. Stated size: 61 x 20 cm. Product weight: 230 kg. Quantity: 4 pack.
Water resistant construction suitable for occasional outdoor moisture exposure.
Zip fastening allows easy access to arrange contents and secure storage.
Compact 61 x 20 cm design fits neatly into smaller spaces or displays.
Includes a 4-pack of festive black plastic wreaths for coordinated decoration.
Comes with 4x Christmas Wreaths

Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.
